name: Universal Template
description: Fixed title + subtitle over decorative background. LLM invents a dense, age-appropriate multi-section educational activity as dynamic HTML (1:1 image slots).

fieldPrompts.main_topic: 2–4 word purple header title. Never empty. Never a question. No ! or ?.
fieldPrompts.sub_topic: 1–3 word blue-banner skill label. Never a question. No ! or ?.
fieldPrompts.instruction_text: One short learner instruction sentence for the whole page. ! only if it is a full sentence.
fieldPrompts.labels: Short editable on-page labels / trace words. No ! or ? on 1–3 word labels.

aiSystemPrompt: You edit a single worksheet field. Return JSON {"value": ...} only. Plain text only — do not generate HTML or CSS.
samplePrompt: Create a fun Grade 2 worksheet about animal sounds with learn, match, and circle activities.
